item.title: Papablic, of USA Recalls Convertible Bedside Sleepers Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Entrapment, Suffocation and Fall Hazards; Violate Mandatory Standard for Play Yards
item.company: Sold Online At: Amazon.com and papablic.com from April 2025 through July 2026 for about $190.
item.brand: Sold Online At: Amazon.com and papablic.com from April 2025 through July 2026 for about $190.
item.product: Papablic Bedside Sleepers with Play Yard Extensions
item.summary: This recall involves Papablic bedside sleepers, model PAPA03001AI. These convertible sleepers function as both a bassinet and a play yard and have a gray exterior with an interior printed in a stars‑and‑moon pattern. The products have "Papablic" stitched in white on the front gray fabric panel. Model "PAPA03001AI" is printed on a label sewn to the interior fabric of the bassinet underneath the mattress pad.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: Papablic Bedside Sleepers with Play Yard Extensions.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the convertible bedside sleeper immediately and contact Papablic for a refund. Consumers will be asked to disassemble the product, cut the mattress and fabric components in half and email photos of the destroyed components to support@papablic.com. Upon receipt of proof of destruction, Papablic will issue a full refund and consumers should dispose of the product.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
